notes.title: Updated 7 Apr 2016
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new build has been uploaded to address a few issues

- 2 crash bugs [details in the known issue topic in the forum]
- added GUI icons to represent what your engineers are currently carrying

.. there will be larger updates adding features and content but these were pressing issues affecting gameplay and have been deployed urgently.

If there are any questions or comments please do let us know here, on the forum, via our website or our twitter.

Best Regards

Ross Edgar.
